name: Band Bracelet LV Flourish
description:
Add a touch of high-fashion luxury to your wrist with the Band Bracelet LV Flourish. This sleek 925 sterling silver band is perfect for stacking or shining all on its own.
It’s a chic, contemporary statement piece designed for the trend-setting woman.

name: Band Bracelet Snowflake
description: Capture the magic of winter with the dainty and luminescent Band Bracelet Snowflake. Crafted in pure sterling silver, this delicate design brings a timeless, frosted elegance to your everyday look.

name: Band Bracelet Bow Beauty
description: Effortlessly feminine and charming, the Band Bracelet Bow Beauty brings a sweet, sophisticated accent to your jewelry collection. This polished sterling silver band curves into a beautiful, minimalist bow that catches the light perfectly.

name: Band Bracelet Infinite Love
description: Celebrate timeless affection with the elegantly winding Band Bracelet Infinite Love. Its polished infinity symbol serves as a beautiful, glowing reminder of endless connection, making it an essential everyday staple.

name: Band Bracelet Casino Night
description: Bring a sense of playfulness and high-stakes style to your ensemble with the striking Band Bracelet Casino Night. This bold, polished silver band infuses immediate personality and an upscale edge into any look.

name: Band Bracelet Royal Beauty
description: Command attention with the regal and sophisticated architecture of the Band Bracelet Royal Beauty. Its classic, pristine sterling silver finish adds a majestic crown of elegance to any outfit choice.

name: Band Bracelet Travel Love
description: Fuel your wanderlust with this belt bracelet. Inspired by the rushed mornings of travel, this easy-to-use stretchable, minimalistic band serves as the perfect understated companion for your daily journeys.

name: Band Bracelet Patch of Bow
description: The Band Bracelet Patch of Bow delivers structured symmetry and clean lines. A suave, minimalist sterling silver band that effortlessly complements a tailored suit or casual attire.

name: Band Bracelet Luxury love 1
description: Define your signature look with the heavy, high-shine finish of the women's Band Bracelet Luxury Love 1. Crafted in pure 925 silver, its timeless and robust design speaks volumes about refined taste and confident feminity.

name: Band Bracelet Luxury love 2
description: The perfect blend of clean, modern lines and unmatched luxury craftsmanship. The men's Band Bracelet Luxury Love features an upgraded, premium silhouette meant to anchor your style without putting a dent in your wallet.

name: Band Bracelet Pure LV
description: Minimalist chic at its finest. This pure sterling silver band features a crisp, high-fashion layout that grounds your everyday attire with effortless luxury.

name: Band Bracelet Love Birds
description: Celebrate romance with a whimsical touch. Two beautifully detailed silver love birds sit atop this polished band, delivering a sweet and timeless look.

name: Band Bracelet Heart Love
description: Wear your heart on your sleeve. This premium silver band curves elegantly into a classic heart motif, offering a romantic touch perfect for daily wear or gifting.

name: Band Bracelet Luxury love 3
description: Bold, premium, and undeniably sleek. This heavy-finish 925 sterling silver band delivers a commanding wrist presence that elevates both tailored suits and casual weekend attire.

name: Band Bracelet Mahadev
description:
Wear your belief, embrace spirituality and style with the 925 Silver Mythological Series Bracelet. Featuring a sleek stretchable belt, this bracelet combines timeless design with modern comfort.
Styling Tip: Pair this bracelet with a crisp white shirt and tailored trousers for an effortlessly classy look or wear it on a kurta for traditional occasions. Perfect for spiritual gatherings, festive occasions, or elevating everyday wear.

name: Intricate Love
description: Fall in love with vintage artistry. This intricately detailed oxidized silver bracelet beautifully captures old-world charm with a romantic twist, making it the perfect boho-chic statement piece for your daily wardrobe.

name: Ginni Bracelet
description: Celebrate timeless heritage with the beautifully textured Ginni Bracelet. Pair it with our Oxidized Jhumkas and you are good to go for festivities, navratri or contemporary wear. Add an effortless touch featuring a stunning antique oxidized finish.

name: Indian Charms Bracelet - Pink Flowers
description: Crafted for girls who carry a little jingle with them, wear the garden of dainty happiness in Pink Flowers Indian Charms Bracelet. Its rustic, oxidized craftsmanship is perfectly balanced by delicate floral detailing, bringing a playful yet vintage vibe to your wrist.

name: Indian Charms Bracelet - Garba balls
description: Infuse festive joy and cultural rhythm into your style with the Garba Balls Indian Charms Bracelet. Handcrafted with an antique oxidized silver finish, its dangling charm elements dance gracefully with your every movement.

name: Indian Charms Bracelet - Daisies
description: Charm your way through the day with the whimsically retro Daisies Indian Charms Bracelet. The deep contrast of premium oxidized silver makes the delicate floral charms pop, creating a striking accessory for nature lovers.

name: Twisted Love
description: Experience the unmatched fluidity and high-shine polish of fine Italian craftsmanship. This stunningly minimalist silver bracelet features a sophisticated twisted silhouette that wraps your wrist in effortless luxury

name: 3 toned 5-line Bracelet
description: Why settle for one when you can have it all? This exquisite 5-line Italian bracelet effortlessly weaves together three metallic tones, creating a high-fashion, shimmering masterpiece that matches every outfit seamlessly.

name: Ring Cum Bracelet
description: Make a bold fashion statement with this ultra-modern, high-utility Ring Cum Bracelet. Fusing sleek Western style with everyday versatility, this brilliant sterling silver piece effortlessly transforms to elevate your look from casual chic to evening glam.

name: Diamond in Rose Gold Bracelet
description: Indulge in romantic luxury with this breathtaking Rose Gold finished bracelet, adorned with brilliant, diamond-like stones. It delivers a soft, luminous glow that adds immediate sophisticated sparkle to your evening wear.

name: Sapphire Diamonds Bracelet
description: Channel royal allure with the deep, captivating blue tones of the Sapphire Diamonds Bracelet. Flawlessly cut stones mimic the brilliance of rare gems against a modern, pristine silver setting, perfect for your next special occasion.

name: Polki with Mor studded Sapphires
description: Royal heritage reimagined. Deep blue sapphires frame an intricate peacock design highlighted by timeless Polki stones, setting a majestic tone for festive occasions.

name: Green Pearly Night Wrist Cuff
description: Command the room with this statement wrist cuff. Classic Polki setting is elevated by rich green accents and delicate pearl drops for unmatched festive glamour.

name: Polki Gold Bracelet
description: Pure traditional craftsmanship. Shimmering Polki stones are set in an premium gold-finished silver band, delivering an heirloom-quality look for the modern festive wardrobe.

name: Nandi Heritage Jhumkas
description: Tap into ancient roots with an edgy, indo-western vibe. Bold, stylized Nandi motifs drop into detailed oxidized jhumkas, making them the ultimate statement piece for saree lovers.

name: Mother of Pearl Drops
description: Pristine mother of pearl elements drop from a hint of oxidized frames, creating a beautiful contrast built for everyday elegance.

name: Love triangle with a Polki
description: Contemporary geometry meets antique elegance. These eye-catching triangular earrings feature brilliant Polki stonework to give your modern ensembles a regal upgrade.

name: The Emerald Mandala Studs
description: Center your festive styling with these intricate mandala studs. Radiant emerald-colored stones pop against classic Polki detailing, offering a balanced and luxurious design.

name: Green Square Stud Jhumkis
description: A timeless classic with a modern twist. Geometric square studs drop gracefully into traditional silver jhumkis, highlighted by rich green tones and brilliant stones.

name: Mor Jhumkis
description: Intricate royal artistry. These heavy-shining silver jhumkis showcase an elusive peacock detailing paired with shimmering stones, dancing elegantly with your every step.

name: Temple Peacock Flourish with meenakari
description: Divine grandeur come to life. These majestic temple earrings feature vibrant meenakari enamel work over intricate gold-finish peacock motifs, ideal for traditional bridal styling.

name: Layered Polki Set
description: A majestic statement for festive occasions. This stunning set layers traditional Polki craftsmanship to drape your neckline in timeless, antique luxury.

name: 2-Layer Clover Leaf
description: Double the style, double the luck. This effortlessly layered sterling silver chain features delicate clover motifs, bringing a fresh and modern touch to your daily office attire.

name: Nail Charm with Chain
description: Edgy design meets minimalist elegance. A striking charm in curved nail hangs from a high-shine silver chain, creating the perfect contemporary conversation piece for night outs.

name: The Scar
description: Unapologetically bold and uniquely yours. This avant-garde silver necklace features a raw, abstract design meant for those who use jewelry to make a confident statement.

name: 2-Layer Heart
description: Simple, romantic, and beautifully stacked. This pre-layered dainty silver chain lets you wear your heart on your neckline with a sweet, sophisticated sparkle.

name: 2-Layer Chain with medal
description: Give your outfit an instant premium upgrade. A classic, high-shine silver medal drops from layered fine chains to anchor your contemporary wardrobe with vintage charm.

name: Silver Swan with diamond
description: Elegant grace in every detail. A beautifully sculpted sterling silver swan carries a brilliant diamond-like accent, creating a timeless solitaire-style piece that catches the light effortlessly

name: Autumn with maple leaves
description: Capture the magic of changing seasons. Intricately detailed maple leaf charms dance along a delicate silver chain, introducing a warm, natural elegance to your look.

name: Daisy Jhumkis
description: Traditional jhumkis reimagined with a fresh, floral twist. Shimmering Polki elements form a delicate daisy top, dropping into intricate silver bells that bounce beautifully with every step

name: Triple Traingles with Polki Studs
description: Geometric symmetry at its finest. Rich Polki studs open into an architectural triple-triangle drop, delivering a striking fusion of modern lines and antique royalty.

name: Red Danglers
description: Ignite your look with a splash of color. Perfect for those occasions require a touch of Indianness in us, these red cut stones are framed by polished silver, delivering a striking pop of glamour.

name: Devangana Ear Cuffs
description: True celebrity-style styling for the art lover. These dramatic oxidized silver ear cuffs wrap your ears in detailed ethnic patterns, immediately transforming any Indo-western look.

name: Royal Procession DangleRS
description: Wear a piece of history. These striking oxidized silver danglers showcase hand-carved heritage motifs, capturing a majestic royal essence that beautifully complements traditional sarees.

name: Chand-Nandi Halo Studs
description: Divine craftsmanship in an everyday size. Sacred Nandi motifs are set inside a textured crescent halo, creating a rustic, oxidized statement stud that pairs perfectly with ethnic fusion wear.

name: The Charms in Steps collection: Swan & Clover luck
description: Elevate your stride with playful charms. Take each step with swan and lucky clover charms on an adjustable silver anklet, a sparkling reminder of charm and fortune.

name: Mountain or Sea Brooch
description: Approx - 4cm x 3cm

name: The Iridescent Angel Wing Brooch
description: Whimsical fantasy meets high-luxury craftsmanship. This breathtaking brooch features vibrant abalone shell wings framed by a pave-set silver silhouette and anchored by a striking, cream-colored pearl. A magnificent centerpiece that catches the light with every movement.

name: The Emerald Wildflower Bouquet Brooch
description: Carry an everlasting bouquet of sophisticated sparkle wherever you go. Intricate, marquise-cut crystal petals burst outward from deep emerald-green centers, complemented by sleek, contrasting black enamel leaves. An effortlessly chic floral accessory designed to elevate day wear into evening glamour.

name: The Enchanted Blossom Brooch
description: Capture the serene beauty of spring with this exquisite botanical statement piece. Delicate mother-of-pearl flowers bloom alongside lustrous pearls on a sweeping branch finished in a warm, romantic rose gold polish. It’s a breath of fresh air for your favorite blazer or evening dress.

name: The Onyx & Emerald Panther Brooch
description: Exude fierce confidence and effortless power. This fiercely sophisticated panther brooch is encrusted with brilliant, diamond-cut crystals, featuring piercing emerald-green eyes and sleek black onyx accents as it guards a solitary premium pearl. Perfect for adding a bold, wild luxury to a classic lapel.

name: The Pastel Petals Pearl Brooch
description: Use it as a brooch for men, pendant for women. A masterclass in vintage charm, this geometric floral brooch features metallic petals dipped in a delicate pastel pink enamel, framing a central cluster of pristine white pearls and brilliant-cut diamond stimulants. It adds an immediate touch of soft, regal elegance to any outfit.

name: The Scarlet Silhouette Butterfly Brooch
description: Make a rich, passionate statement. This unique, sculptural butterfly brooch contrasts deep burgundy-red enamel textures with a brilliant, sweeping wing path of micro-pave crystals and a luminous drop pearl. A bold conversation starter designed for the trend-setting wardrobe.

name: The Prism Bird of Paradise Brooch
description: Celebrate vibrant luxury with this pave-encrusted hummingbird brooch. Meticulously set with high-shining crystals, it features a striking ruby-red eye and a tail accented by deep sapphire, citrine, and emerald-toned stones. A joyful, sparkling work of art that instantly brightens up monochrome attire.

name: The Gilded Hummingbird Brooch
description: Capture the beauty of nature in mid-flight. Drenched in a warm gold finish and entirely encrusted with brilliant micro-pave stones, this exquisite hummingbird brooch features a subtle gemstone eye that flashes with every turn. An ultra-premium accent piece that infuses any lapel or scarf with effortless vitality.

name: The Emerald Isle Fawn Brooch
description: Whimsical storytelling meets fine high-jewelry luxury. A pave-studded silver fawn with piercing emerald-green eyes rests beneath a sweeping crown of marquise-cut crystal leaves, delicately dropping a solitary luminous pearl. It’s an enchanting, head-turning accessory designed for your most elegant occasions.

name: The Royal Tiger Portrait Brooch
description: Exude untamed confidence and sheer power. This fiercely designed tiger brooch showcases a brilliant pave-set metallic face framed by structural baguette crystals and striking emerald-colored eyes. A bold, architectural masterpiece that commands immediate attention on a black blazer or formal jacket.

name: The Crystal Silhouette Tulip Brooch
description: Graceful romance captured in a timeless botanical silhouette. This structural tulip brooch features a closely set crystal bulb supported by a cascading stem of perfectly aligned baguette stones for a sleek, fluid shimmer. A beautifully minimalist statement of contemporary elegance.

name: The Mother-of-Pearl Dragonfly Brooch
description: Let your style take flight with this masterfully textured art-deco piece. Iridescent mother-of-pearl wings flank a central solitary pearl body, balanced beautifully by a sleek, crystal-studded rose gold tail. A lightweight, ethereal accessory that brings a soft, luminescent glow to daytime ensembles.

name: The Bee You Brooch
description: Add a sweet yet powerful sting of luxury to your favorite outfit. This heavily detailed queen bee brooch features shimmering crystal-dusted wings layered over a distinct body accented with alternating rows of midnight-black stones. The ultimate statement of modern luxury and chic personality.

name: The Baguette Sunburst Watch-Dial Brooch
description: An avant-garde masterpiece inspired by vintage horology. A luminous mother-of-pearl central watch-style dial is framed by a double-layered explosion of clear, icy baguette crystals that catch the light from every imaginable angle. The perfect blend of structural geometry and high-fashion watch-art styling.

name: The Leaping Reindeer Enamel Brooch
description: Celebrate a spirit of untamed grace and elegant motion. This fluid, gold-finished leaping reindeer brooch features a glossy, textured pearl-enamel body, detailed crystal collar, and a playful dangling mini pearl. A festive yet timelessly elegant heirloom piece built to lift your winter wardrobe.

name: The Canary Yellow Sunflower Brooch
description: Wear your own ray of pure sunshine. A dense, brilliant pave center gives way to a vibrant halo of rich, canary-yellow gemstone petals, all resting on a sweeping, fluid silver ribbon stem. A joyful, high-energy statement accessory that instantly brightens up monochrome suits and dark winter outerwear.

name: The Emerald Fringe Panther Ring Brooch
description: High-drama couture styling for the bold fashion lover. A magnificent, micro-pave jaguar crouches confidently atop a sleek, polished black resin ring, suspending a dramatic curtain of linear crystal chains tipped with rich emerald-green glass drops. A heavy, statement-making masterpiece that dances gracefully with your every movement.

name: The Crystal Owl Brooch
description: Channel effortless charm and classic wisdom with this beautifully detailed owl brooch, finished in a warm, radiant rose gold tone. Its striking midnight-black eyes are framed by a brilliant pave crown, cascading down into a textured plumage of shimmering, marquise-cut crystals. A captivating conversation starter that adds a hint of playful luxury to any jacket lapel.

name: The Textured Enamel Umbrella Brooch
description: Perfect for brightening up any gloomy day, this delightful umbrella brooch combines structural silver artistry with a playful, artistic spirit. Featuring a rich, dual-tone textured enamel canopy in soft crimson and teal, it is beautifully anchored by a sleek, twisted silver handle. Pin it to your favorite trench coat or scarf for an instant pop of color and personality.

name: The Imperial Cheetah Ring Brooch
description: Make a fierce fashion statement with this avant-garde, structural masterpiece dipped in luxurious rose gold. A sleek, black-spotted cheetah rests gracefully within a dramatic, architectural wheel of channel-set baguette crystals designed to catch the light from every angle. It's the ultimate power accessory for the modern trendsetter who loves bold, animal-inspired couture.

name: The Majestic Emerald Swan Brooch
description: Indulge in royal elegance with a breathtaking swan brooch that commands immediate attention. A magnificent, deep-emerald green teardrop crystal serves as the focal point, beautifully framed by a gracefully curved neck of micro-pave accents and a sweeping wing of brilliant baguette stones. A timeless symbol of grace and luxury, perfect for your most unforgettable occasions.

name: The Ethereal Mother-of-Pearl Dragonfly Brooch
description: Capture the fleeting poetry of nature with this breathtakingly delicate dragonfly brooch. Luminous, custom-cut mother-of-pearl wings radiate a soft, iridescent glow, beautifully balanced by a brilliant marquise-cut crystal core and a single, flawless dangling pearl. An exquisite, heirloom-quality piece that brings quiet sophistication to both daytime and evening ensembles.

name: The Shopping Girl Brooch
description: Celebrate the joy of high fashion and retail therapy with this uniquely charming, hand-detailed character brooch. Crafted with a luminous cat's-eye stone face, a textured silver ponytail, and vibrant enameled boots and bags, this piece is bursting with playful energy. It is the perfect cheeky, stylish accent to gift a girlfriend or to showcase your own lively love for couture.

name: The Geometric Pear & Pearl Ring Brooch
description: A masterclass in modern asymmetry and timeless luxury. This architectural open-circle brooch seamlessly balances smooth panels of iridescent mother-of-pearl with brilliant pave-set crystal borders, anchored by a striking pear-cut focal stone and a solitary floating pearl. Pin it to a structured jacket or formal gown for an instantly elevated, contemporary look.

name: The Zen Pearl Bamboo Branch Brooch
description: Infuse your wardrobe with natural tranquility and a vibrant pop of artisan color. This masterfully sculpted silver bamboo brooch is accented by gradient green-and-lime enamel leaves, shimmering green crystal details, and a magnificent, large premium white pearl that mimics a dewdrop in the sun. A refreshing, conversational accessory that radiates organic elegance.

name: The Amethyst Fields Lavender Brooch
description: Carry the romantic beauty of a blooming garden wherever you go. This delicately detailed botanical brooch features a sweeping silver stem nestled against diamond-bright textured leaves, blossoming into a rich cluster of vibrant marquise-cut amethyst crystals. An exquisite, deeply elegant touch of color that beautifully transforms simple blouses and winter knits alike.

name: The Rose Gold Budding Branch Brooch
description: Evoke the romantic charm of a secret garden with this exquisite, rose gold-finished botanical brooch. Featuring a polished, soft pink stone bud nestled within pave-sparkled petals, it is beautifully balanced by a rustic twig stem and a singular, lustrous pearl. Pin it to your favorite outerwear for an instant touch of poetic, feminine elegance.

name: The Twin Pink Crystal Lily Brooch
description: Double the elegance with a stunning sterling silver double-lily brooch designed to capture the light. Twin calla-style blooms showcase brilliant pear-cut pink crystals framed by a radiant fan of baguette-cut stones, meeting gracefully at a single white pearl. This piece is a masterclass in romance and high-wattage sophistication.

name: The Marcasite Sterling Elephant Brooch
description: Bring a touch of good fortune and vintage charm to your wardrobe with this meticulously crafted 925 sterling silver elephant brooch. Paved with glittering, metallic-hued marcasite stones, its textured body catches the light beautifully with every movement. A timeless, symbolic accessory that adds a spirited, antique-inspired flair to any lapel or scarf.

name: The Amethyst Fields Lavender Brooch (White)
description: Celebrate nature's serenity with this beautifully detailed lavender stem brooch, featuring a rich cluster of marquise-cut purple crystals. Set against a textured sterling silver stem and shimmering leaves, it captures the quiet beauty of blooming French meadows. It is the perfect delicate accessory to bring a sophisticated pop of color to neutral knits.

name: The Imperial Pearl Snowflake Brooch
description: Capture the magic of winter with this dazzling snowflake brooch, featuring a brilliant-cut center stone radiating outward with ice-like baguette crystals. Finished with six pristine white pearls capping each tip, this piece is a striking celebration of symmetry and seasonal elegance. Let it add a frosty, high-society shimmer to your favorite coat or evening wrap.

name: The Emerald Dual Butterfly Brooch
description: Embrace the spirit of transformation with this captivating dual-butterfly brooch. A bold, artistic statement piece that instantly breathes life and color into any outfit.

name: The Rose Gold Dual Butterfly Brooch
description: Embrace the spirit of transformation with this captivating dual-butterfly brooch. A bold, artistic statement piece that instantly breathes life and color into any outfit.

name: The Yellow-Crystal Exotic Bird Brooch
description: Exude royal sophistication with this breathtaking bird brooch, shimmering with an intricate coat of micro-pave crystals. Its focal point is a majestic, golden-yellow teardrop crystal, beautifully balanced by a single dangling pearl that adds a classic finish. A magnificent accessory designed to capture the spotlight at your next special event.

name: The I-Heart-Mother-of-Pearl & Baguette Brooch
description: A stunning blend of organic luster and modern geometry. This heart shaped brooch features a large, iridescent slice of premium mother-of-pearl, crowned by a cascading, open-work lattice of brilliant baguette-cut crystals.

name: The Royal Heritage Dual-Tone Ear Cuff (Kaan Phool)
description: Channel regal grandeur with this show-stopping, dual-tone tribal ear cuff that intricately hugs the entire ear with artistic brilliance. Adorned with a vibrant emerald-hued top accent, pearl-studded mango motifs, and a detailed gold-toned elephant charm, it is dramatically finished with cascading silver-toned chains. A magnificent heirloom-style statement piece designed to turn heads at festive celebrations and weddings alike.

name: The Royal Sapphire & Pearl Chandbali Hoops
description: Channel timeless Indian heritage with these regal oxidized silver crescent hoops, designed to make a grand statement. Rich sapphire-blue stones line the inner curve, perfectly framed by a lush fringe of delicate seed pearls that sway gracefully with every step. An irresistible heirloom piece crafted to elevate your favorite ethnic and fusion ensembles.

name: The Pastel Floral Enamel Heart Huggie Earrings
description: Add a touch of playful romance to your daily sparkle with these charming sterling silver huggie hoops. Each drop features a soft enamel heart encrusted in diamond-bright crystals, surrounding an artisan floral motif for a sweet, vintage-inspired pop of color.

name: The Turquoise & Twin Bird Jhumka Earrings
description: Infuse your style with bohemian spirit and handcrafted charm through these oxidized silver jhumkas. A unique, eye-catching accessory that brings authentic cultural flair to modern looks.

name: The Marcasite Leaf & Black Bead Jhumka Earrings
description: Vintage elegance meets dramatic movement in these stunning oxidized silver drop earrings. A brilliant leaf stud cradles a classic jhumka dome, beautifully finished with a dancing trim of midnight-black beads.

name: The Royal Blue Jhumki Chain Drops
description: Dance with these dramatic long-line threader-style jhumka earrings. Intricately linked marcasite-studded chains lead down to delicate silver domes fringed with rich, light-catching sapphire-blue beads.

name: The Paisley Polki Jhumkas
description: Celebrate royal traditions with these antique gold-toned jhumkas, featuring classic paisley studs. A classic dome base drops gracefully with cluster pearl accents, creating a timeless silhouette for festive occasions.

name: The Royal Red Jhumka
description: Turn heads with these majestic statement chandelier earrings featuring carved ruby-toned central stones suspended from pave-encrusted arches. Delicate mini-jhumkas and dangling pearl-and-garnet beads create mesmerizing movement with every step.

name: The Polki Bali
description: Bring effortless, everyday sparkle to your jewelry box with these classic gold-toned silver huggie hoop earrings. Perfect for layering in a multi-piercing look or wearing solo for understated glamour.

name: The Emerald & Polki Fan Stud Earrings
description: Make an opulent statement with these stunning fan-shaped stud earrings, encrusted with rich emerald-green teardrop stones and brilliant polki-style crystals. Crafted with antique gold-toned silver, their regal geometric arrangement effortlessly frames the face. A captivating choice for evening galas, weddings, and grand celebrations.

name: The Small Latkan earrings
description: Exude soft, feminine grace with these delicate drop earrings featuring sparkling halo-set center stones. Subtle micro-pave detailing leads down to a lush fringe of natural white seed pearls that dance with subtle elegance. A dreamy, ethereal accessory designed for brides, bridesmaids, or special evening affairs.

name: The Temple Peacock & Pearl Chandelier Jhumka
description: Immerse yourself in heritage craftsmanship with these intricate temple-style silver earrings featuring detailed peacock motifs and a crescent halo. Encrusted with brilliant stones and finished with delicate pearl drops, they capture the magnificent essence of traditional Indian artistry. A striking heirloom piece made to stand out at grand festive occasions.

name: The Honeycomb Uncut Diamond Drop Earrings
description: Discover a modern twist on classic stone settings with these artisan gold-toned silver drop earrings. A openwork honeycomb-lattice panel is framed in micro-pave crystals and anchored by bold, teardrop uncut-style stones. Lightweight yet eye-catching, they offer an unforgettable blend of contemporary texture and classic radiance.

name: The Heritage Hoop Earrings
description: Redefine bridal opulence with these magnificent oversized hoop earrings fringed with three dancing Kundan-encrusted jhumka domes. Sparkling stones form a grand circular silhouette that cascades into cluster pearls for maximum drama and movement. Designed for the bold trendsetter looking to make an unforgettable entrance.

name: The Emerald & Midnight Blue Enamel Chain Link Drops
description: Step into modern luxury with these artfully crafted sterling silver chain-link drop earrings. Featuring alternate links highlighted in micro-pave crystals, rich emerald green enamel, and deep navy accents, they offer a sophisticated pop of color. Sleek and vibrant, they bring a high-fashion edge to both tailored daytime outfits and chic evening wear.
